_comment: Pi Coding Agent provider config for the API container. Contains NO credentials and is safe to commit: apiKey below is the dummy string Ollama ignores. The DeepSeek key is supplied at runtime from the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable and is never written here.
_deepseek_note: DeepSeek is deliberately ABSENT. It is a BUILT-IN Pi provider that resolves DEEPSEEK_API_KEY by exact provider name. Adding a custom provider named 'deepseek' here shadows the built-in and breaks credential resolution -- measured in Phase 4.5.
